'''Mike Kessling''' (GEMP troop1023) is a member of [[New Allies]] and is listed as '''Production Advocate''' on the May 2024 Players Committee organization chart, with forum handle '''Kessling''' and role contact production@starwarsccg.org. That Advocate header role is '''new''' relative to the July 2021 org-chart Advocate row (which instead listed Matt Carulli as Special Projects &amp; Multimedia Advocate).<ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref><ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]</ref>

== Documented PC roles ==

* '''Org chart 2021:''' Not on the Advocate header row in the cited snapshot.<ref name="orgchart2021" />
* '''Org chart 2024:''' Production Advocate; handle '''Kessling'''.<ref name="orgchart2024" />
